info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Careers Applications Withdraw-v1-spec
info.description: The Withdraw Job Applications API allows users to remove their job applications from consideration. This endpoint is essential for candidates who wish to retract their applications for various reasons, such as accepting an alternate position or changing their career plans. By providing a straightforward mechanism to withdraw applications, this API enhances the job-seeking experience and maintains an up-to-date application status for recruiters. Typical consumers include job applicants and automated job application management systems.

delete.description: This endpoint allows a user to withdraw their application from consideration. It is essential for users to understand that once an application is withdrawn, it cannot be reinstated. Ensure that this action is intended before proceeding.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to withdraw an application. It should contain the necessary data to identify the application being withdrawn.

204.description: The request was successfully processed, and no content is returned.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the DELETE operation related to applications withdrawal.
